Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner files a memo seeking withdrawal of the Criminal Petition.

The memo so filed reads as follows:
"MEMO FOR WITHDRAWAL The counsel for the petitioner submits as follows, That the petitioner will not continue this petition since there chargesheet is already filed in the Crime No.160/2023 and numbered as S.C. No.115/2025.

In light of the same liberty may be granted to the petitioner further if any consequences arising in the same S.C.No.115/2025 which is pending before the District and Sessions Judge Bengaluru Rural, to file a fresh petition.
